products.name: Alteryx AI
products.note: Analytics automation with AI; data blending; workflow governance; self-service analytics risk

profile_text.body:
Alteryx is a data and analytics company whose site describes it as "a leading AI-ready data and analytics company that powers actionable insights to help organizations drive smarter, faster decisions with data." Its flagship offering, Alteryx One, is presented as a full-spectrum analytics platform that connects enterprise data sources such as ERPs, CRMs, data lakes, and files, including integrations with Oracle, Microsoft, Snowflake, and Databricks, without requiring data to be copied. The site states the platform can prepare and blend data up to 100 times faster and that predictive analytics automation can save up to 170 FTE hours a month.

Alteryx's AI product, tracked on this site as Alteryx AI, covers analytics automation, data blending, workflow governance, and self-service analytics. The platform combines predictive analytics, machine learning, and generative AI capabilities and is positioned toward business users who build automated data workflows through low-code and no-code tools. The company describes itself as rated a leader across multiple 2026 analyst evaluations for making advanced analytics and AI trustworthy at enterprise scale, and cites customers including McLaren Racing and Nielsen among its reference users.

The held facts note that Alteryx has a profile page on this site and no recorded litigation, MCP server presence, or SEC or patent filings in the current dataset.
